props.title: Climb the stairs
props.goalText: Climb the staircase to the flag using at most 5 blocks.
props.alt: A robot climbs a staircase on a 6 by 6 grid from the bottom left to the top right. The same four moves repeat five times, so the learner wraps them in a repeat block. Practises spotting a pattern and using a loop.
hints: Find the moves for one stair.
Put them in a repeat block.
